scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of default branch (depth 20); has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false), not the author's working copy. Project is a QGIS desktop plugin (Python, PyQt via qgis.PyQt) plus JSON mode files, SVG icons and Markdown docs; no web server, database or network client code found. Dev tools in tools/ use exec(compile(Path(...).read_text())) to load scripts from a hardcoded Windows path inside the QGIS Python console (developer-only helpers, not part of the shipped plugin) and subprocess.run for 'cmd /c mklink /J' with fixed arguments. Files under docs/ (including docs/qgis-processing-algorithms.xlsx) and screens_errors/ were inventoried but not scanned. Interface and data-access detection patterns in the skill are web/DB oriented; for a desktop plugin these sections are largely empty by design. Personal author email appears in src/qgismodes/metadata.txt (standard QGIS plugin metadata, not a secret).

gitignore_gaps: *.pem, *.key, credentials.json and similar credential file patterns are not excluded (standard Python template only excludes .env, .venv, venv)

python.package_manager: none (QGIS plugin; metadata.txt declares plugin_dependencies=QuickMapServices,Data Plotly)
findings: No requirements.txt/pyproject.toml; no pip-level dependencies declared
Optional import of jsonschema in src/qgismodes/mode_loader.py with a hand-rolled fallback validator; jsonschema is not declared anywhere
Runtime depends on QGIS (qgisMinimumVersion=3.44, qgisMaximumVersion=4.99) and the QGIS-bundled Python/Qt

file_system_access.detail: reads mode JSON files and mode.schema.json from the bundled and per-profile modes folders
copies bundled mode files into the user's QGIS profile modes folder (shutil.copy2)
imports mode JSON files from user-chosen paths (shutil.copyfile) and writes/exports mode JSON to user-chosen destinations
creates a Windows junction (cmd /c mklink /J) from the QGIS plugin directory to a hardcoded C:\Users\<author>\Github\QGISModes\src\qgismodes path

what_this_app_can_do: Lets a QGIS desktop user define several simplified QGIS interfaces ('modes') as JSON files and switch between them at runtime by showing or hiding toolbars, panels, menus and processing algorithms.
Imports and exports mode definition files to and from user-chosen locations on the local file system.
Stores the active mode in QGIS settings and user modes in the active QGIS profile folder.

data_sources_touched.source: Mode definition JSON files (bundled src/qgismodes/modes/ and per-profile qgismodes/modes/ folder)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Runs only inside the local QGIS desktop session of whoever installs it; no network listener, no authentication layer, no remote interface.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: No outbound network calls, credentials or database access found in the plugin source.
Developer helper scripts in tools/ execute script text read from a hardcoded local path via exec() inside the QGIS console; they are not loaded by the plugin itself.

top_findings: No committed secrets, no network or database access found in plugin source
Developer tools in tools/ use exec(compile(...)) on files from a hardcoded author-specific Windows path (not part of the shipped plugin)
No dependency manifest beyond QGIS metadata.txt; optional jsonschema import is undeclared
Project README states the repo is an early skeleton, not a working plugin
